name: sodium lauryl sulfate
description: Harsh surfactant that can cause skin and eye irritation. May disrupt skin barrier function.

name: parabens
description: Preservatives that may disrupt hormone function and cause allergic reactions.

name: formaldehyde
description: Known carcinogen that can cause allergic reactions and respiratory issues.

name: triclosan
description: Antimicrobial agent that may contribute to antibiotic resistance and hormone disruption.

name: phthalates
description: Plasticizers that may disrupt hormones and affect reproductive health.

name: aluminum chloride
description: May cause skin irritation and there are concerns about aluminum exposure.

name: synthetic fragrances
description: May contain allergens and chemicals that can cause reactions.

name: glycerin
description: Natural humectant that helps retain moisture. Generally safe and beneficial.

name: hyaluronic acid
description: Excellent moisturizing ingredient that helps skin retain water.

name: vitamin e
description: Antioxidant that protects skin from free radical damage.

name: ceramides
description: Natural lipids that help restore and maintain skin barrier function.

name: niacinamide
description: Beneficial ingredient that helps improve skin texture and reduce inflammation.

name: retinol
description: Anti-aging ingredient, but can cause irritation in sensitive skin.

name: salicylic acid
description: Exfoliating ingredient that helps unclog pores. May cause dryness.

name: zinc oxide
description: Natural mineral sunscreen ingredient that provides broad spectrum protection.

name: titanium dioxide
description: Natural mineral sunscreen ingredient, safe and effective UV protection.

name: oxybenzone
description: Chemical sunscreen that may disrupt hormones and cause coral reef damage.

name: octinoxate
description: Chemical sunscreen with potential hormone disrupting effects.

name: mineral oil
description: May clog pores and prevent skin breathing, but generally safe.

name: phenoxyethanol
description: Mild preservative, generally safe but may cause irritation in sensitive skin.

name: sodium laureth sulfate
description: Milder surfactant than SLS but can still cause irritation. May contain traces of carcinogenic compounds.

name: cetyl alcohol
description: Fatty alcohol that acts as emollient and emulsifier. Generally safe and beneficial.

name: dimethicone
description: Silicone that provides smooth feel and protects skin. Generally safe but may cause buildup.

name: panthenol
description: Soothing and moisturizing ingredient. Helps repair skin barrier.

name: allantoin
description: Gentle soothing ingredient that promotes skin healing and reduces irritation.
